ran_first_pass: position-effect permutation null (2000 shuffles of first/later labels, this runner)
ran_second_pass_oct27: bayes.fit (Pyro, LKJ prior + NUTS) per topic: posterior coupling for all 72 pairs, 0 divergences
Pyro position-effect posteriors per question (small Pyro model, new integration code): credible ranges replace the normal approximations
noncommutative.NonCommutativeBeliefModel fitted jointly per topic: FAILED fit (worse NLL than the commutative comparator on 12/12 topics) — reported, not used
noncommutative per-pair fits: fitted order effects mean 0.163 vs 0.066 measured; beat commutative NLL on 28/72 pairs — reported, not used as evidence
quantum.cross_check (PennyLane circuit vs torch): 12/12 topics agree, max diff 6.7e-16
machinery.correction: The first pass claimed torch/pyro/pennylane were 'not installed in this sandbox'. They were installed all along in the survey engine's own venv (torch 2.14.1, pyro 1.9.2, pennylane 0.45.1); the first pass ran under the system Python. Second-pass outputs: engine-run-full-2026-10-27.json, engine-run-pair-fits-2026-10-27.json.
